overview: We join your Shopify store as staff and do a first round of real upkeep. We check products, collections, navigation, apps, theme and checkout, write down what we find, then fix the safe items ourselves and agree the rest with you. You get a short written summary of every change, so you always know what was touched. It is a fixed starter sprint, and monthly care is quoted separately.

faq: Do you need my Shopify password?
No. You add us as a staff account from Settings, then Users, with only the permissions the work needs. You can remove us at any time, and everything we change is listed in the summary we send.
Is this the same as a monthly plan?
No. This is a fixed starter sprint: one round of checks and fixes. If you want us to keep going every month, we quote that separately once we have seen how much your store needs.
What counts as a small fix?

Things like a broken link, a wrong image size, a missing alt text, a hidden section or a settings mistake. Bigger jobs, like a redesign or a new feature, are quoted on their own so the sprint stays on time.
Will you change my live store without asking?
We make safe edits straight away and write them down. Anything that changes how the store looks or sells, such as prices or theme code, we agree with you first and test on a duplicate theme.
